character: feverish purple octopus, white towel on his head, red eyes, loose tie, eight arms, fills two thirds of frame
props: thermometer in one arm from 0.3; eight loads, one per arm - coffee pot, drill, stamp, mop, phone, kettle, ledger, laptop; two clerks, their place is his arms until 6.75, never the floor; payslip, one coin
prop_continuity: towel on his head until 7.3; the clerks stay knotted from 6.75 to the end
motion_rule: every window he covers ground TOWARDS the lens and grows in frame - charging, wheeling or barging, never retreating; all eight arms work at once, each doing its job WRONG; new shot size every window
environment: office corridor at the lens, desks both sides, puddle, honour board, lit tank at the lens end, midday sun; background under a third

audio.delivery: flat feverish male voice, blocked nose, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: ra-BO-ta-yu, VO-sem, RUK, zar-PLA-ty, rav-NO, khva-TA-yet, TOL-ko, DVE
audio.pacing: brisk, no drawling; nothing said after 6.75
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, always visible
audio.sfx: wet sniff, coffee splash, drill whine, glass knock

timeline.a: bursts up the corridor spitting the thermometer into a free arm, then charges the lens, eight arms on eight jobs all done wrong, papers flying
timeline.c: wide low to tight frontal, push in

timeline.a: fans all eight arms wide and pours the coffee pot over a clerk's head
drives the spinning drill through a clerk's monitor, sparks fanning at the lens
barges on up the aisle, shoulders down the clerk climbing his back
wheels a full turn, all eight loads whipping out sideways, then charges back with the soaked clerk swinging off one arm
slams the stamp on a clerk's forehead, leaving a mark reading БРАК in black capitals
rips the payslip off his chest and drives at the lens reading it
still striding, swings round with one coin held up, the other six drop their loads
two arms whip the clerks together back to back and knot the mop through their belts, both kicking
he tears the towel off his head and slams it into the puddle at the lens, water bursting up
charges the lens and spits the thermometer into the eye of a photo on the honour board passing his shoulder, reading ДОСКА ПОЧЁТА
timeline.c: big low frontal, board past his shoulder

timeline.a: dives head first into the lit tank at the lens and slams flat on the glass, face filling the frame, ink bursting out behind him
timeline.c: big close on his face through the glass

timeline.a: face squashed on the glass, two arms yank the curtain shut behind him, ink swallows the water black, the knotted clerks hammering beside him
timeline.c: big close held on his face, ink blooming

must_appear: drill through the monitor at 1.95; БРАК at 4.7; the clerks knotted at 6.75; the thermometer in the photo eye at 7.9; his face on the glass to the last frame
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, garbled or misspelled words, Latin letters on the stamp or board, static camera, he stands still while speaking, an arm doing nothing before 6.75, a clerk on the floor before 6.75, the towel off his head before 7.3, fewer than eight arms, English speech, any word after 6.75, a shot without him, his back to the lens, him small or far off, him hidden by the ink, a still final frame
